doe_box_behnken — MULTIVAR plan op

• Data kinds: none → design (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.doe_box_behnken(factors=3, center=3) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import doe; doe.doe_box_behnken(factors=3, center=3) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsmultivar.get("doe_box_behnken"))

Usage

Box-Behnken design (Box & Behnken 1960) for 3, 4 or 5 factors -> design.

Three levels per factor and no run at a corner of the cube: for every pair of factors, a 2^2 factorial (±1, ±1) with all other factors at 0, plus center centre runs — 12, 24 and 40 edge runs for k = 3, 4, 5 (the pair construction of Box & Behnken's table for these k). Useful when the extreme corners are unsafe or cannot be set. k = 4 is rotatable. Larger k use incomplete-block constructions that are not reproduced here and are refused.
